hypotheses.claim: Because the L2a hook is a single pre-loop vectorized scoring pass (p50 ~2.45 ms, 500 ms budget leaves >100x slack), combining an evolved global-scale generalized-savings merge order with a `relocate_2opt` post-pass will strictly improve on the M2 zero-postprocess dev_24 reference of 16.1398 and on the bare CW+relocate+2opt reference of 16.1549: the merge order builds long radial edges while the post-pass removes the inter-route waste that static pairwise scoring cannot see (KB flags 'no_post_merge_inter_route_relocate' as the L2a weak regime). Success criterion: mean tour length on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 < 16.1398 with zero scale-invariance drift (1e-3 rescaling) and no budget truncation.

next_search_advice.direction: Evolve `score_merge_static` as a global depot-distance-scale normalized generalized savings rule: score = (d0i+d0j - lam*dij + mu*|d0i-d0j|)/mean(d0[1:]) + beta*clip((qi+qj)/Q,0,1), with lam in [1.00,1.15], mu in [0.08,0.15], beta in [0.05,0.15], plus an optional demand-balance term 1-|qi-qj|/(qi+qj). Forbid any per-pair local normalization (d0i+d0j-dij)/(d0i+d0j). Prefer a slightly more fill-aggressive variant than the M2 fixed-strong config since the cheap relocate_2opt post-pass can repair the tail fragments that aggressive capacity-fill merging creates.
